    severe — sai · "severe" đồng nghĩa với serious.
  • B
    grave — sai · "grave" đồng nghĩa với serious.
  • C
    deep — sai · "deep" không trái nghĩa.
  • D
    minor — đúng · "serious" (nghiêm trọng) trái nghĩa với "minor" (nhỏ, không đáng kể).

items.q: According to paragraph 2, income from tourism helps to ____________.
items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: A
  • A
    repair old buildings — đúng · bài nêu "income from tourism pays for the repair of old buildings".
  • B
    build new airports — sai · không nhắc xây sân bay.
  • C
    reduce the number of visitors — sai · giảm khách là biện pháp ở đoạn 3, không phải tác dụng của thu nhập.
  • D
    close old towns — sai · không nhắc đóng cửa thị trấn.

items.q: The word “they” in paragraph 3 refers to ____________.
items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: A
  • A
    visitors — đúng · "the very places they come to enjoy" – "they" quay lại "too many visitors".
  • B
    places — sai · "places" là danh từ ngay trước nhưng là tân ngữ của "enjoy".
  • C
    paintings — sai · "paintings" là đối tượng bị chạm vào.
  • D
    stones — sai · "stones" là đối tượng bị giẫm lên.

items.q: Which of the following is NOT mentioned as damage caused by tourists?
items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: B
  • A
    Touching wall paintings — sai · có nhắc chạm tranh tường.
  • B
    Cutting down old trees — đúng · bài không nhắc việc chặt cây cổ.
  • C
    Leaving rubbish — sai · có nhắc xả rác.
  • D
    Walking on ancient stones — sai · có nhắc đi lên đá cổ.

items.q: The phrase “take responsibility” in paragraph 4 could be best replaced by ____________.
items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: B
  • A
    lose control — sai · "lose control" = mất kiểm soát.
  • B
    be in charge — đúng · "take responsibility" ≈ "be in charge of/chịu trách nhiệm".
  • C
    avoid blame — sai · "avoid blame" = né tránh lỗi, trái nghĩa.
  • D
    give advice — sai · "give advice" = khuyên bảo, khác nghĩa.

items.q: Which of the following best paraphrases the sentence “However, too many visitors can damage the very places they come to enjoy”?
opts: Large numbers of tourists may harm the sites that attract them.
Historic places are damaged only by local people.
Visitors enjoy places more when they damage them.
Tourists never damage any historic place they visit.
items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: A
  • A
    Large numbers of tourists may harm the sites that attract them. — đúng · diễn đạt đúng: quá nhiều khách có thể làm hại chính những nơi thu hút họ.
  • B
    Historic places are damaged only by local people. — sai · "only by local people" sai.
  • C
    Visitors enjoy places more when they damage them. — sai · "enjoy more when damage" sai.
  • D
    Tourists never damage any historic place they visit. — sai · "never damage" mâu thuẫn.

items.q: Which of the following is TRUE according to the passage?
opts: Some sites restrict how many tourists can enter each day.
All historic sites are free for visitors.
Tour companies are the only group responsible for protection.
Heritage tourism has no economic benefits.
items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: A
  • A
    Some sites restrict how many tourists can enter each day. — đúng · đoạn 3: "limit the number of tourists per day".
  • B
    All historic sites are free for visitors. — sai · bài không nói miễn phí.
  • C
    Tour companies are the only group responsible for protection. — sai · đoạn 4 nói cả chính quyền, công ty và du khách đều có trách nhiệm.
  • D
    Heritage tourism has no economic benefits. — sai · đoạn 2 nêu nhiều lợi ích kinh tế.

items.q: Which of the following best summarises the passage?
opts: Local authorities alone can solve all problems of tourism.
Heritage tourism helps communities but must be managed to protect historic places.
Old temples are more important than modern buildings.
Tourists should stay away from ancient towns for ever.
items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: B
  • A
    Local authorities alone can solve all problems of tourism. — sai · "alone" trái với ý cần phối hợp.
  • B
    Heritage tourism helps communities but must be managed to protect historic places. — đúng · tóm tắt: lợi ích kinh tế đi kèm nhu cầu bảo vệ, cần cân bằng.
  • C
    Old temples are more important than modern buildings. — sai · so sánh đền chùa và nhà hiện đại không có trong bài.
  • D
    Tourists should stay away from ancient towns for ever. — sai · "stay away for ever" cực đoan, bài không nói.

exercises.title: Câu 31–40 · Đọc hiểu
exercises.instruction: Đọc bài đọc rồi chọn đáp án đúng nhất cho mỗi câu hỏi (câu 31–40).
exercises.passage:
1[I] Over the past decade, online learning has moved from the margins of education to the centre. [II] Millions of students now attend classes through video calls, submit homework on digital platforms, and watch recorded lectures whenever they like. [III] This shift was greatly accelerated by the pandemic, but it has not disappeared since schools reopened. [IV]

2Perhaps the biggest advantage of online learning is flexibility. Students can study at their own pace, repeat difficult lessons and choose times that suit their daily routines. This is especially valuable for those who live far from good schools or who must juggle study with part-time work. Online courses also give learners access to teachers and materials from all over the world.

3Nevertheless, the model has weaknesses. Without a fixed timetable and a teacher nearby, many students lose motivation and fall behind. Technical problems, such as unstable internet connections, can interrupt lessons and widen the gap between students who have good equipment and those who do not. Furthermore, online classes offer fewer chances for face-to-face discussion, which is important for developing communication skills.

4Many schools have therefore adopted a blended approach, combining online activities with traditional lessons. In this way, students enjoy flexibility without losing contact with their teachers and classmates. Educators believe that this balance is likely to define the future of education.

(Adapted from an educational journal)
exercises.tr: Học trực tuyến đã trở thành một phần quan trọng của giáo dục: linh hoạt, tiếp cận được giáo viên khắp nơi, nhưng dễ mất động lực, phụ thuộc thiết bị và thiếu thảo luận trực tiếp. Vì vậy nhiều trường chọn hình thức kết hợp trực tuyến và truyền thống.

items.q:
Where in paragraph 1 does the following sentence best fit?
As a result, many schools had to teach online almost overnight.
items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: D
  • A
    [I] — sai · sau [I] chưa có nguyên nhân nào để nói "kết quả".
  • B
    [II] — sai · sau [II] chưa nhắc đến đại dịch.
  • C
    [III] — sai · sau [III] câu vẫn chưa kết thúc ý về hậu quả; "As a result" phải theo sau nguyên nhân đã nêu đầy đủ.
  • D
    [IV] — đúng · đặt cuối đoạn, sau câu nói đại dịch đẩy nhanh sự thay đổi → "As a result".

items.q: The word “juggle” in paragraph 2 could be best replaced by ____________.
items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: A
  • A
    balance — đúng · "juggle study with work" = cân bằng học và làm.
  • B
    neglect — sai · "neglect" = bỏ bê.
  • C
    postpone — sai · "postpone" = trì hoãn.
  • D
    abandon — sai · "abandon" = từ bỏ.

items.q: According to paragraph 2, online learning is especially useful for students who ____________.
opts: have a lot of free time
items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: D
  • A
    dislike technology — sai · không nhắc ghét công nghệ.
  • B
    prefer fixed timetables — sai · "prefer fixed timetables" ngược với lợi thế linh hoạt.
  • C
    have a lot of free time — sai · người rảnh nhiều không phải đối tượng nêu.
  • D
    live far from good schools — đúng · bài nêu "those who live far from good schools".

items.q: The word “those” in paragraph 3 refers to ____________.
items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: C
  • A
    connections — sai · "connections" không đi với "who".
  • B
    lessons — sai · "lessons" không đi với "who".
  • C
    students — đúng · "those who do not" = những học sinh không có thiết bị tốt.
  • D
    problems — sai · "problems" không đi với "who".

items.q: Which of the following is NOT mentioned as a weakness of online learning?
opts: There are fewer chances for face-to-face discussion.
Online lessons are always more expensive than classroom lessons.
items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: B
  • A
    There are fewer chances for face-to-face discussion. — sai · có nêu ít thảo luận trực tiếp.
  • B
    Online lessons are always more expensive than classroom lessons. — đúng · bài không nói học trực tuyến luôn đắt hơn.
  • C
    Students may lose motivation. — sai · có nêu mất động lực.
  • D
    Internet problems may interrupt lessons. — sai · có nêu sự cố internet.

items.q: Which of the following best paraphrases the underlined sentence in paragraph 4?
opts: Schools have already stopped using blended learning.
Teachers think online learning will soon replace all classrooms.
Teachers expect that a mixture of online and classroom learning will shape education in the future.
Educators doubt that any balance can be found in education.
items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: C
  • A
    Schools have already stopped using blended learning. — sai · "already stopped" sai.
  • B
    Teachers think online learning will soon replace all classrooms. — sai · "replace all classrooms" sai.
  • C
    Teachers expect that a mixture of online and classroom learning will shape education in the future. — đúng · diễn đạt đúng: sự kết hợp sẽ định hình tương lai giáo dục.
  • D
    Educators doubt that any balance can be found in education. — sai · "doubt" trái nghĩa.

items.q: Which of the following is TRUE according to the passage?
opts: All students have equally good equipment.
Online learning disappeared after schools reopened.
Online courses are available only in one country.
Many schools combine online and traditional lessons.
items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: D
  • A
    All students have equally good equipment. — sai · đoạn 3: có khoảng cách thiết bị.
  • B
    Online learning disappeared after schools reopened. — sai · đoạn 1: "has not disappeared".
  • C
    Online courses are available only in one country. — sai · đoạn 2: tiếp cận giáo viên khắp thế giới.
  • D
    Many schools combine online and traditional lessons. — đúng · đoạn 4: "adopted a blended approach".

items.q: Which of the following can be inferred from the passage?
opts: Teachers are no longer needed in modern education.
Recorded lectures are less useful than live ones.
Online learning is suitable for every student in the same way.
Students with unstable internet may fall behind their classmates.
items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: D
  • A
    Teachers are no longer needed in modern education. — sai · "no longer needed" trái với blended approach.
  • B
    Recorded lectures are less useful than live ones. — sai · bài không so sánh bài giảng ghi hình với trực tiếp.
  • C
    Online learning is suitable for every student in the same way. — sai · bài nêu cả điểm yếu nên không "mọi học sinh như nhau".
  • D
    Students with unstable internet may fall behind their classmates. — đúng · suy ra từ đoạn 3: sự cố kỹ thuật làm rộng khoảng cách.

items.q: In which paragraph does the writer mention a solution that combines two methods?
items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: D
  • A
    Paragraph 1 — sai · đoạn 1 giới thiệu xu hướng.
  • B
    Paragraph 2 — sai · đoạn 2 nói lợi ích.
  • C
    Paragraph 3 — sai · đoạn 3 nói điểm yếu.
  • D
    Paragraph 4 — đúng · đoạn 4: blended approach (kết hợp trực tuyến và truyền thống).

items.q: Which of the following best summarises the passage?
opts: Online learning is perfect and should replace schools.
The pandemic is the only reason for educational change.
Technical problems make online learning impossible.
Online learning offers flexibility but has drawbacks, so blended learning is seen as a promising direction.
items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: D
  • A
    Online learning is perfect and should replace schools. — sai · "perfect… replace schools" sai.
  • B
    The pandemic is the only reason for educational change. — sai · "only reason" sai.
  • C
    Technical problems make online learning impossible. — sai · "impossible" cực đoan.
  • D
    Online learning offers flexibility but has drawbacks, so blended learning is seen as a promising direction. — đúng · tóm tắt đủ lợi ích – điểm yếu – giải pháp kết hợp.

src: Đề tự soạn bám cấu trúc đề tham khảo THPT 2025–2026, chủ đề học trực tuyến – đọc sách – du lịch

title: Đề 05 · Đề tự soạn theo ma trận THPT 2026 (số 3)

exercises.title: Câu 1–5 · Sắp xếp câu
exercises.instruction: Chọn phương án sắp xếp các câu/lời thoại thành một đoạn hội thoại hoặc đoạn văn hợp lý (câu 1–5).
exercises.passage:
Câu 1

a. Lan: Hello, is this the language centre?

b. Receptionist: Yes, it is. How can I help you?

c. Lan: I’d like to know when the next English course starts.

Câu 2

a. Tom: It was great! The beaches were clean and the food was delicious.

b. Anna: How was your trip to Da Nang last week?

c. Tom: I’d love to go back there next summer.

d. Anna: Sounds wonderful. I hope I can visit it one day.

Câu 3

Dear Sir or Madam,

a. I am writing to complain about the laptop I bought from your shop last week.

b. The screen stopped working after only two days.

c. I would therefore like you to replace it or give me a full refund.

d. I look forward to hearing from you soon.

Yours faithfully, Minh

Câu 4

a. Moreover, public libraries offer quiet places where students can study without distraction.

b. Reading regularly provides young people with many advantages.

c. First of all, it widens their vocabulary and improves their writing skills.

d. In conclusion, reading should become a daily habit for every student.

Câu 5

a. Many young people now prefer to buy second-hand clothes for these reasons.

b. Second-hand clothes are much cheaper than new ones.

c. In addition, buying them helps to reduce the waste produced by the fashion industry.

d. Fast fashion has become a major cause of environmental damage.

items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: B
  • A
    b – a – c — sai · b là lời đáp, không mở đầu.
  • B
    a – b – c — đúng · chào hỏi (a) → nhân viên đáp (b) → nêu yêu cầu (c).
  • C
    a – c – b — sai · c nêu yêu cầu trước khi nhân viên hỏi giúp gì.
  • D
    c – a – b — sai · c đứng đầu khi chưa chào hỏi.
💡 Trong điện thoại: chào/xác nhận → hỏi giúp gì → yêu cầu.

✔ Đáp án đúng: C
  • A
    a – b – c – d — sai · a trả lời câu hỏi chưa được hỏi.
  • B
    b – c – a – d — sai · c nói chuyện "go back" trước khi kể chuyến đi.
  • C
    b – a – c – d — đúng · hỏi chuyến đi (b) → kể (a) → mong quay lại (c) → Anna đáp (d).
  • D
    b – a – d – c — sai · c là câu của Tom phải đi trước phản hồi d.
💡 "It was great!" trả lời cho câu hỏi "How was…?".

✔ Đáp án đúng: D
  • A
    b – a – c – d — sai · b nêu lỗi trước khi nói đang phàn nàn điều gì.
  • B
    a – c – b – d — sai · c đề nghị trước khi nêu vấn đề.
  • C
    a – b – d – c — sai · d là câu kết thư, phải đứng cuối.
  • D
    a – b – c – d — đúng · mục đích (a) → vấn đề (b) → yêu cầu (c) → kết (d).
💡 "therefore" ở c chỉ kết quả của vấn đề nêu ở b.

✔ Đáp án đúng: A
  • A
    b – c – a – d — đúng · chủ đề (b) → First of all (c) → Moreover (a) → kết (d).
  • B
    b – a – c – d — sai · "Moreover" phải theo sau ý đầu tiên (c).
  • C
    c – b – a – d — sai · c "First of all" không thể mở đầu khi chưa có câu chủ đề.
  • D
    b – c – d – a — sai · d là kết luận, không đứng trước a.
💡 "In conclusion" luôn ở cuối đoạn.

✔ Đáp án đúng: B
  • A
    b – d – c – a — sai · b nói "cheaper than new ones" trước khi có chủ đề chung.
  • B
    d – b – c – a — đúng · vấn đề (d) → lý do 1 (b) → lý do 2 (c) → kết luận "these reasons" (a).
  • C
    d – c – b – a — sai · c "In addition" phải sau ý b.
  • D
    a – d – b – c — sai · a có "these reasons" nên phải đứng cuối.
💡 "these reasons" chỉ lại các lý do vừa nêu.

exercises.title: Câu 6–11 · Điền từ vào đoạn
exercises.instruction: Đọc đoạn văn rồi chọn phương án phù hợp nhất cho từng chỗ trống đánh số (câu 6–11).
exercises.passage:
City Cycling Day

Join our City Cycling Day, an event 6 aims to reduce traffic and pollution in the city centre.

What to expect

Thousands of people are expected to 7 part in the event. Roads in the centre will be closed 8 traffic from 8 a.m. to noon.

Useful information

Cyclists are 9 to bring their own bikes, but rental bikes will also be available. A 10 helmet is compulsory for everyone. 11 the weather is bad, the event will be moved to the following Sunday.

items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: B
  • A
    whose — sai · "whose" cần danh từ ngay sau.
  • B
    which — đúng · "which" thay cho "an event", làm chủ ngữ của "aims".
  • C
    where — sai · "where" chỉ nơi chốn, sau nó cần một mệnh đề đầy đủ.
  • D
    who — sai · "who" chỉ người.

✔ Đáp án đúng: C
  • A
    join — sai · "join part" không tồn tại ("join in" hoặc "take part in").
  • B
    make — sai · "make part" sai collocation.
  • C
    take — đúng · "take part in" = tham gia.
  • D
    do — sai · "do part" không tồn tại.

✔ Đáp án đúng: D
  • A
    for — sai · "closed for traffic" không dùng.
  • B
    at — sai · "at traffic" sai giới từ.
  • C
    in — sai · "in traffic" nghĩa là "trong lúc kẹt xe".
  • D
    to — đúng · "closed to traffic" = cấm xe cộ đi qua.

✔ Đáp án đúng: D
  • A
    encouragement — sai · "encouragement" là danh từ.
  • B
    encouraging — sai · "encouraging" là tính từ/V-ing, không hợp nghĩa bị động.
  • C
    encourage — sai · "encourage" là nguyên mẫu, sai sau "are".
  • D
    encouraged — đúng · "be encouraged to V" = được khuyến khích làm gì (bị động).

✔ Đáp án đúng: D
  • A
    safeness — sai · "safeness" hiếm dùng, không hợp.
  • B
    safely — sai · "safely" là trạng từ.
  • C
    safe — sai · "safe helmet" không phải cụm cố định.
  • D
    safety — đúng · "safety helmet" = mũ bảo hiểm (danh từ bổ nghĩa cho danh từ).

✔ Đáp án đúng: A
  • A
    If — đúng · "If the weather is bad" = nếu thời tiết xấu.
  • B
    Although — sai · "Although" chỉ nhượng bộ, không hợp.
  • C
    Despite — sai · "Despite" cần danh từ/V-ing, không đi với mệnh đề.
  • D
    Unless — sai · "Unless" = nếu không, đảo nghĩa.

exercises.title: Câu 12–19 · Đọc hiểu
exercises.instruction: Đọc bài đọc rồi chọn đáp án đúng nhất cho mỗi câu hỏi (câu 12–19).
exercises.passage:
1Remote work, once a rare benefit offered by a few companies, has become a normal part of working life for millions of people. Supporters say it offers freedom and efficiency, while critics worry about its hidden costs.

2One of the main attractions of remote work is the time it saves. Employees no longer spend hours stuck in traffic, and they can use that time for rest, exercise or family. Companies benefit too, since they can reduce the cost of renting large offices.

3On the other hand, working alone for long periods can be tiring in a different way. Many remote workers report feeling isolated, especially when they miss the casual conversations that happen naturally in an office. Some also find it hard to stop working in the evening because their home has become their workplace.

4To deal with these problems, some firms organise regular online meetings and occasional social events. Employees themselves are advised to set clear boundaries, for example by finishing work at a fixed time every day.

(Adapted from a business magazine)
exercises.tr: Làm việc từ xa tiết kiệm thời gian và chi phí cho cả nhân viên lẫn công ty, nhưng có thể gây cô lập và khó tách biệt công việc với nghỉ ngơi. Công ty tổ chức họp trực tuyến, còn nhân viên nên đặt ra giới hạn rõ ràng.

items.q: The word “hidden” in paragraph 1 is OPPOSITE in meaning to ____________.
items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: D
  • A
    secret — sai · "secret" đồng nghĩa.
  • B
    concealed — sai · "concealed" đồng nghĩa.
  • C
    unseen — sai · "unseen" đồng nghĩa.
  • D
    obvious — đúng · "hidden" (ẩn) trái nghĩa "obvious" (rõ ràng).

items.q: According to paragraph 2, remote work helps employees to ____________.
items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: A
  • A
    avoid long journeys to work — đúng · đoạn 2: không còn mất hàng giờ kẹt xe.
  • B
    earn higher salaries — sai · không nhắc lương cao hơn.
  • C
    work fewer hours each week — sai · không nhắc làm ít giờ hơn.
  • D
    change jobs easily — sai · không nhắc đổi việc dễ dàng.

items.q: The word “they” in paragraph 2 refers to ____________.
items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: D
  • A
    employees — sai · "employees" đứng ở câu trước.
  • B
    hours — sai · "hours" không thể "reduce the cost".
  • C
    offices — sai · "offices" là tân ngữ của "renting".
  • D
    companies — đúng · "Companies benefit too, since they can reduce…" – "they" = companies.

items.q: Which of the following is NOT mentioned as a problem of remote work?
opts: Difficulty finishing work in the evening
Salaries are always lower than in offices.
items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: C
  • A
    Feeling isolated — sai · có nêu cảm giác cô lập.
  • B
    Difficulty finishing work in the evening — sai · có nêu khó dừng làm việc buổi tối.
  • C
    Salaries are always lower than in offices. — đúng · bài không nói lương thấp hơn.
  • D
    Missing casual conversations — sai · có nêu thiếu trò chuyện thường ngày.

items.q: The phrase “set clear boundaries” in paragraph 4 is closest in meaning to ____________.
items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: A
  • A
    establish firm limits — đúng · "set clear boundaries" = đặt ra giới hạn rõ ràng.
  • B
    break the rules — sai · "break the rules" = phá luật.
  • C
    avoid all work — sai · "avoid all work" = tránh mọi việc.
  • D
    expand duties — sai · "expand duties" = mở rộng nhiệm vụ.

items.q: Which of the following best paraphrases the sentence “Some also find it hard to stop working in the evening because their home has become their workplace”?
opts: Evening work is impossible at home.
Because they work where they live, some people struggle to finish work at night.
Some people refuse to work at home in the evening.
Workplaces have become homes for all employees.
items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: B
  • A
    Evening work is impossible at home. — sai · "impossible" sai.
  • B
    Because they work where they live, some people struggle to finish work at night. — đúng · đúng nghĩa: làm việc ở nhà nên khó dừng buổi tối.
  • C
    Some people refuse to work at home in the evening. — sai · "refuse to work" sai.
  • D
    Workplaces have become homes for all employees. — sai · "all employees" sai.

items.q: Which of the following is TRUE according to the passage?
opts: Remote work is available in only a few companies today.
All employees prefer working in an office.
Remote work has no advantages for companies.
Some companies hold online meetings to reduce isolation.
items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: D
  • A
    Remote work is available in only a few companies today. — sai · đoạn 1: đã phổ biến với hàng triệu người.
  • B
    All employees prefer working in an office. — sai · bài không nói thế.
  • C
    Remote work has no advantages for companies. — sai · đoạn 2: công ty cũng có lợi.
  • D
    Some companies hold online meetings to reduce isolation. — đúng · đoạn 4: công ty tổ chức họp online, sự kiện xã hội.

items.q: Which of the following best summarises the passage?
opts: Remote workers never feel tired or lonely.
Offices are better than homes for every type of work.
Remote work saves time and money but can cause isolation, so firms and workers need to manage it carefully.
Remote work should be banned in all companies.
items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: C
  • A
    Remote workers never feel tired or lonely. — sai · "never feel tired" sai.
  • B
    Offices are better than homes for every type of work. — sai · "better for every type" bài không nói.
  • C
    Remote work saves time and money but can cause isolation, so firms and workers need to manage it carefully. — đúng · tóm tắt đủ lợi – hại – cách xử lý.
  • D
    Remote work should be banned in all companies. — sai · "banned" cực đoan.

exercises.title: Câu 20–25 · Điền từ vào đoạn
exercises.instruction: Đọc đoạn văn rồi chọn phương án phù hợp nhất cho từng chỗ trống đánh số (câu 20–25).
exercises.passage:
Teenagers and Sleep

Many teenagers do not get enough sleep. 20 the school day starts early, they often go to bed late because of homework and phones. As a 21, they feel tired and find it hard to concentrate.

Doctors 22 that teenagers switch off screens an hour before bed. Keeping a regular sleep schedule can also 23 the quality of sleep. A cool, quiet and dark room helps people 24 asleep more quickly.

Getting enough sleep is not a luxury; 25, it is a basic need.

items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: C
  • A
    When — sai · "When" không diễn đạt tương phản.
  • B
    Because — sai · "Because" chỉ nguyên nhân, sai logic.
  • C
    Although — đúng · "Although" chỉ sự tương phản: lịch học sớm nhưng vẫn ngủ muộn.
  • D
    Since — sai · "Since" cũng chỉ nguyên nhân/mốc thời gian.

✔ Đáp án đúng: A
  • A
    result — đúng · "as a result" = do đó.
  • B
    matter — sai · "as a matter" thiếu "of fact".
  • C
    reason — sai · "as a reason" không tồn tại.
  • D
    way — sai · "as a way" không hợp nghĩa.

✔ Đáp án đúng: A
  • A
    advise — đúng · "advise that…" là động từ.
  • B
    advisory — sai · "advisory" là tính từ.
  • C
    advice — sai · "advice" là danh từ.
  • D
    advisable — sai · "advisable" là tính từ, không đứng sau chủ ngữ "Doctors".

✔ Đáp án đúng: A
  • A
    improve — đúng · sau "can" dùng động từ nguyên mẫu: "can improve".
  • B
    improving — sai · "improving" sai sau động từ khuyết thiếu.
  • C
    improved — sai · "improved" sai sau động từ khuyết thiếu.
  • D
    improvement — sai · "improvement" là danh từ.

✔ Đáp án đúng: C
  • A
    falling — sai · "falling" không dùng sau "help sb".
  • B
    fell — sai · "fell" là quá khứ.
  • C
    fall — đúng · "help sb + V" : "helps people fall asleep".
  • D
    fallen — sai · "fallen" là quá khứ phân từ.

✔ Đáp án đúng: A
  • A
    in fact — đúng · "in fact" = thực ra, nhấn mạnh ý vừa nêu.
  • B
    in contrast — sai · "in contrast" chỉ tương phản, không hợp.
  • C
    as a result — sai · "as a result" không có quan hệ nhân quả.
  • D
    for example — sai · "for example" không đưa ra ví dụ.

exercises.title: Câu 26–30 · Điền từ vào đoạn
exercises.instruction: Đọc đoạn văn rồi chọn phương án phù hợp nhất cho từng chỗ trống đánh số (câu 26–30).
exercises.passage:
WORKING FROM HOME

Working from home has become increasingly common in recent years. 26. Many employees enjoy this arrangement because they save time and money on travelling.

Another advantage is flexibility. Workers can arrange their tasks 27, which often makes them more productive. However, remote work is not perfect for everyone. People who live alone 28, and the line between work and rest can easily become blurred.

To make the most of working from home, experts suggest creating a quiet workspace 29. They also advise taking regular breaks 30.

(Adapted from a business website)

opts: Working from home was invented in the nineteenth century.
Most companies have banned employees from using computers at home.
Few people have ever heard of this working style.
Thanks to modern technology, many jobs no longer need to be done in an office.
items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: D
  • A
    Working from home was invented in the nineteenth century. — sai · "nineteenth century" sai và không liên quan.
  • B
    Most companies have banned employees from using computers at home. — sai · "banned" mâu thuẫn với "increasingly common".
  • C
    Few people have ever heard of this working style. — sai · "few people have heard" mâu thuẫn "increasingly common".
  • D
    Thanks to modern technology, many jobs no longer need to be done in an office. — đúng · câu mở dẫn vào lợi ích tiết kiệm thời gian, tiền bạc.

✔ Đáp án đúng: B
  • A
    around their own schedule — sai · thiếu "s" không hợp "their own schedules" số nhiều ở ngữ cảnh.
  • B
    around their own schedules — đúng · "arrange tasks around their own schedules" = sắp xếp xung quanh lịch trình riêng.
  • C
    about their own schedules — sai · "about" không hợp collocation.
  • D
    between their own schedules — sai · "between" cần hai đối tượng.

opts: may feels lonely without daily contact with colleagues
may to feel lonely without daily contact with colleagues
may feeling lonely without daily contact with colleagues
may feel lonely without daily contact with colleagues
items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: D
  • A
    may feels lonely without daily contact with colleagues — sai · sau "may" không chia động từ.
  • B
    may to feel lonely without daily contact with colleagues — sai · sau "may" không dùng "to".
  • C
    may feeling lonely without daily contact with colleagues — sai · sau "may" không dùng V-ing.
  • D
    may feel lonely without daily contact with colleagues — đúng · "may + V nguyên mẫu".

opts: who they can concentrate without being disturbed
which they can concentrate without being disturbed
what they can concentrate without being disturbed
where they can concentrate without being disturbed
items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: D
  • A
    who they can concentrate without being disturbed — sai · "who" chỉ người.
  • B
    which they can concentrate without being disturbed — sai · "which" cần có giới từ ("in which").
  • C
    what they can concentrate without being disturbed — sai · "what" không đứng sau danh từ.
  • D
    where they can concentrate without being disturbed — đúng · "where" thay cho nơi chốn (workspace).

opts: so that they do not become exhausted
in order they do not become exhausted
for they do not become exhausted
so that they not become exhausted
items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: A
  • A
    so that they do not become exhausted — đúng · "so that + mệnh đề" chỉ mục đích.
  • B
    in order they do not become exhausted — sai · "in order" cần "that" hoặc "to".
  • C
    for they do not become exhausted — sai · "for" trước mệnh đề dùng như "bởi vì", không chỉ mục đích.
  • D
    so that they not become exhausted — sai · phủ định sai: thiếu trợ động từ.

exercises.title: Câu 31–40 · Đọc hiểu
exercises.instruction: Đọc bài đọc rồi chọn đáp án đúng nhất cho mỗi câu hỏi (câu 31–40).
exercises.passage:
1[I] Artificial intelligence, or AI, is no longer a topic found only in science-fiction films. [II] It now helps doctors read medical images, allows banks to detect fraud, and enables farmers to predict the weather. [III] Many people, however, fear that smart machines will take their jobs. [IV]

2History offers some reassurance. When factories introduced machines in the nineteenth century, many workers lost their jobs, but new kinds of work appeared. In the same way, AI is likely to make some tasks obsolete while creating new roles, such as data analysts and AI trainers. Experts therefore argue that the real challenge is not the loss of jobs but the need to learn new skills.

3Education systems will play a decisive role. Schools can no longer simply ask students to memorise facts, because machines can store and search information far faster than humans. Instead, they should teach creativity, critical thinking and the ability to work with others, abilities that machines still find difficult to copy.

4Nevertheless, governments and companies share responsibility. Providing affordable training for workers whose jobs are affected is essential if the benefits of AI are to be shared fairly. Without such support, the technology could widen the gap between those who can use it and those who cannot.

(Adapted from a technology magazine)
exercises.tr: Trí tuệ nhân tạo đang làm thay đổi công việc. Lịch sử cho thấy máy móc làm mất một số nghề nhưng tạo nghề mới; điều quan trọng là học kỹ năng mới. Trường học cần dạy sáng tạo, tư duy phản biện; chính phủ và doanh nghiệp cần hỗ trợ đào tạo.

items.q:
Where in paragraph 1 does the following sentence best fit?
This fear is understandable, but it may be exaggerated.
items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: D
  • A
    [I] — sai · sau [I] chưa có nỗi sợ nào để gọi "This fear".
  • B
    [II] — sai · sau [II] vẫn chỉ nêu ứng dụng AI.
  • C
    [III] — sai · sau [III] là câu nêu nỗi sợ; vị trí chèn đúng là ngay sau đó, tức ở [IV].
  • D
    [IV] — đúng · đặt cuối đoạn sau câu nói nhiều người lo máy móc cướp việc: "This fear" thay cho nỗi sợ vừa nêu.

items.q: The phrase “make some tasks obsolete” in paragraph 2 could be best replaced by ____________.
opts: cause some tasks to become outdated
lead to some tasks being repeated
items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: B
  • A
    create some new tasks — sai · "create new tasks" ngược nghĩa.
  • B
    cause some tasks to become outdated — đúng · "obsolete" = lỗi thời, không còn dùng nữa.
  • C
    lead to some tasks being repeated — sai · "repeated" khác nghĩa.
  • D
    make some tasks easier — sai · "easier" khác nghĩa.

items.q: The word “their” in paragraph 1 refers to ____________.
items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: A
  • A
    many people — đúng · "Many people… fear that smart machines will take their jobs" – "their" = của người lo ngại.
  • B
    machines — sai · "machines" không có "jobs bị lấy".
  • C
    farmers — sai · "farmers" ở câu trước, chỉ là một ví dụ.
  • D
    doctors — sai · "doctors" ở câu trước, chỉ là một ví dụ.

items.q: According to paragraph 2, the real challenge of AI is ____________.
opts: the need to acquire new skills
items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: B
  • A
    the lack of factories — sai · không nhắc thiếu nhà máy.
  • B
    the need to acquire new skills — đúng · "the need to learn new skills".
  • C
    the invention of new machines — sai · không nhắc phát minh máy mới.
  • D
    the loss of all jobs — sai · bài phủ nhận "loss of jobs" là thách thức chính.

items.q: According to paragraph 3, schools should teach ____________.
items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: A
  • A
    creativity and critical thinking — đúng · đoạn 3 nêu creativity, critical thinking, teamwork.
  • B
    how to build machines — sai · không nhắc chế tạo máy.
  • C
    only how to memorise facts — sai · bài phản đối chỉ ghi nhớ sự kiện.
  • D
    how to avoid computers — sai · không nhắc tránh máy tính.

items.q: Which of the following best paraphrases the underlined sentence in paragraph 4?
opts: Affordable training for affected workers is necessary so that everyone can benefit from AI.
Workers who lose jobs should pay for training.
Governments should stop workers from using AI.
AI will benefit only people who are already skilled.
items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: A
  • A
    Affordable training for affected workers is necessary so that everyone can benefit from AI. — đúng · đúng ý: đào tạo giá rẻ cho người bị ảnh hưởng để lợi ích chia đều.
  • B
    Workers who lose jobs should pay for training. — sai · "workers pay" sai.
  • C
    Governments should stop workers from using AI. — sai · "stop workers" sai.
  • D
    AI will benefit only people who are already skilled. — sai · "only skilled" sai.

items.q: Which of the following is TRUE according to the passage?
opts: The nineteenth century saw no new jobs.
Machines can copy human creativity easily.
AI is used only in films.
AI helps banks to detect fraud.
items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: D
  • A
    The nineteenth century saw no new jobs. — sai · đoạn 2 nói có công việc mới xuất hiện.
  • B
    Machines can copy human creativity easily. — sai · đoạn 3 nói máy khó sao chép.
  • C
    AI is used only in films. — sai · đoạn 1 phản bác.
  • D
    AI helps banks to detect fraud. — đúng · đoạn 1: "allows banks to detect fraud".

items.q: Which of the following can be inferred from the passage?
opts: Governments cannot influence AI at all.
Schools no longer need to teach any facts.
Without training support, AI could increase inequality.
items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: D
  • A
    Governments cannot influence AI at all. — sai · bài nêu chính phủ có trách nhiệm.
  • B
    Schools no longer need to teach any facts. — sai · bài chỉ nói không nên chỉ ghi nhớ, không bỏ hẳn.
  • C
    AI will stop developing soon. — sai · bài không nói AI dừng phát triển.
  • D
    Without training support, AI could increase inequality. — đúng · đoạn 4: "widen the gap".

items.q: In which paragraph does the writer mention the role of schools?
items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: C
  • A
    Paragraph 1 — sai · đoạn 1 giới thiệu AI.
  • B
    Paragraph 2 — sai · đoạn 2 nói lịch sử và kỹ năng mới.
  • C
    Paragraph 3 — đúng · đoạn 3: "Education systems will play a decisive role".
  • D
    Paragraph 4 — sai · đoạn 4 nói chính phủ và công ty.

items.q: Which of the following best summarises the passage?
opts: AI will change work, so education and training must prepare people to benefit from it.
AI will replace every worker within ten years.
Machines are less useful than humans in all fields.
The nineteenth century was better than today.
items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: A
  • A
    AI will change work, so education and training must prepare people to benefit from it. — đúng · tóm tắt: AI thay đổi công việc, cần giáo dục và đào tạo.
  • B
    AI will replace every worker within ten years. — sai · "every worker within ten years" sai.
  • C
    Machines are less useful than humans in all fields. — sai · "less useful in all fields" sai.
  • D
    The nineteenth century was better than today. — sai · so sánh thế kỷ không có.

src: Đề tự soạn bám cấu trúc đề tham khảo THPT 2025–2026, chủ đề sự kiện cộng đồng – giấc ngủ – làm việc từ xa – trí tuệ nhân tạo

title: Đề 06 · Đề tự soạn theo ma trận THPT 2026 (số 4)

exercises.title: Câu 1–6 · Điền từ vào đoạn
exercises.instruction: Đọc đoạn văn rồi chọn phương án phù hợp nhất cho từng chỗ trống đánh số (câu 1–6).
exercises.passage:
Recycling Made Simple

Every year, people around the world produce millions of tonnes of rubbish. Much of it could be 1 if we sorted it properly at home.

Paper, glass and metal are the 2 materials to recycle, and many cities now provide separate bins for each type. 3, plastic is harder to deal with because there are so many different kinds.

Reusing items is just as important as recycling them. 4 buying a new bag every time you shop, you can carry a cloth one. Small habits like these can 5 a big difference if millions of people follow them. 6 the environment, we should start today.

items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: A
  • A
    recycled — đúng · bị động sau "could be": "could be recycled".
  • B
    recycling — sai · "recycling" sai dạng sau "be" bị động.
  • C
    recycle — sai · "recycle" sai dạng.
  • D
    recycles — sai · "recycles" sai dạng.

✔ Đáp án đúng: A
  • A
    easiest — đúng · "the easiest materials" – so sánh nhất.
  • B
    ease — sai · "ease" là danh từ/động từ.
  • C
    easier — sai · "easier" là so sánh hơn, thiếu "than".
  • D
    easily — sai · "easily" là trạng từ.

✔ Đáp án đúng: A
  • A
    However — đúng · "However" chỉ sự tương phản: giấy, thủy tinh dễ nhưng nhựa khó.
  • B
    Besides — sai · "Besides" bổ sung ý cùng chiều.
  • C
    Moreover — sai · "Moreover" bổ sung ý cùng chiều.
  • D
    Therefore — sai · "Therefore" chỉ kết quả.

✔ Đáp án đúng: A
  • A
    Instead of — đúng · "Instead of + V-ing" = thay vì.
  • B
    Because of — sai · "Because of" chỉ nguyên nhân.
  • C
    In spite of — sai · "In spite of" chỉ nhượng bộ.
  • D
    According to — sai · "According to" = theo như.

✔ Đáp án đúng: C
  • A
    give — sai · "give a difference" sai.
  • B
    do — sai · "do a difference" sai.
  • C
    make — đúng · "make a difference" = tạo ra sự khác biệt.
  • D
    take — sai · "take a difference" sai.

✔ Đáp án đúng: A
  • A
    To protect — đúng · "To protect the environment, we should…" = mục đích.
  • B
    Protect — sai · dạng mệnh lệnh không hợp ngữ pháp trước chủ ngữ "we".
  • C
    Protecting — sai · "Protecting" chỉ hành động đồng thời, không chỉ mục đích.
  • D
    Protected — sai · "Protected" mang nghĩa bị động.

exercises.title: Câu 7–11 · Điền từ vào đoạn
exercises.instruction: Đọc đoạn văn rồi chọn phương án phù hợp nhất cho từng chỗ trống đánh số (câu 7–11).
exercises.passage:
SOCIAL NETWORKS AND PRIVACY

Social networks make it easy to share our lives with friends, but they also raise serious concerns about privacy. 7. Once a photo is posted, it can be copied and shared by thousands of strangers.

Cyber-security experts warn that personal details, 8, can be used by criminals to steal identities. Young people in particular are often unaware of the risks 9.

To protect themselves, users should adjust their privacy settings and think carefully 10. Parents and teachers can help by 11.

(Adapted from a technology website)

opts: Privacy is no longer important to anyone
Everyone knows exactly who can see their posts
Online information disappears after a few minutes
Many users do not realise how permanent online information can be
items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: D
  • A
    Privacy is no longer important to anyone — sai · "no longer important" mâu thuẫn với "serious concerns".
  • B
    Everyone knows exactly who can see their posts — sai · "Everyone knows exactly" mâu thuẫn với "concerns".
  • C
    Online information disappears after a few minutes — sai · "disappears after a few minutes" mâu thuẫn câu sau.
  • D
    Many users do not realise how permanent online information can be — đúng · câu mở ý: người dùng không nhận ra thông tin trên mạng tồn tại lâu dài, nối với câu sau.

opts: such as addresses and phone numbers are
such as addresses and phone numbers
which such as addresses and phone numbers
items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: B
  • A
    such as addresses and phone numbers are — sai · thêm "are" làm câu thừa động từ.
  • B
    such as addresses and phone numbers — đúng · "such as…" cụm giải thích, đặt giữa hai dấu phẩy.
  • C
    which such as addresses and phone numbers — sai · "which such as" sai cấu trúc.
  • D
    what addresses and phone numbers — sai · "what" không dùng sau danh từ.

opts: who come with sharing personal information online
that come with sharing personal information online
which come with to share personal information online
what come with sharing personal information online
items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: B
  • A
    who come with sharing personal information online — sai · "who" chỉ người.
  • B
    that come with sharing personal information online — đúng · "risks that come with…" – mệnh đề quan hệ chỉ vật.
  • C
    which come with to share personal information online — sai · "to share" sai sau "with".
  • D
    what come with sharing personal information online — sai · "what" không đứng sau danh từ.

✔ Đáp án đúng: A
  • A
    before they post anything — đúng · "before + S + V".
  • B
    before they posting anything — sai · "posting" sai dạng sau chủ ngữ "they".
  • C
    before posting they anything — sai · đảo trật tự từ.
  • D
    before they to post anything — sai · "to post" sai.

opts: to explaining the importance of keeping information private
explained the importance of keeping information private
explaining the importance of keeping information private
explain the importance of keeping information private
items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: C
  • A
    to explaining the importance of keeping information private — sai · "to explaining" sai.
  • B
    explained the importance of keeping information private — sai · "explained" quá khứ sai.
  • C
    explaining the importance of keeping information private — đúng · "by + V-ing": "by explaining…".
  • D
    explain the importance of keeping information private — sai · "explain" nguyên mẫu sai sau giới từ.

exercises.title: Câu 12–17 · Điền từ vào đoạn
exercises.instruction: Đọc đoạn văn rồi chọn phương án phù hợp nhất cho từng chỗ trống đánh số (câu 12–17).
exercises.passage:
Volunteers Needed at Sunshine Library

Sunshine Library is looking for students 12 can spend two hours a week helping young children read.

What will you do?

Volunteers will read stories aloud, help children 13 books, and keep the reading room tidy. No experience is 14, but a friendly attitude is important.

Benefits

You will improve your communication skills and 15 a valuable reference for future job applications. Training sessions are held 16 the first Saturday of every month. Please apply 17 email as soon as possible.

items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: B
  • A
    which — sai · "which" chỉ vật.
  • B
    who — đúng · "who" thay cho "students", làm chủ ngữ của "can".
  • C
    whose — sai · "whose" cần danh từ theo sau.
  • D
    whom — sai · "whom" là tân ngữ.

✔ Đáp án đúng: B
  • A
    choosing — sai · "choosing" không dùng sau "help sb".
  • B
    choose — đúng · "help sb + V": "help children choose books".
  • C
    chose — sai · "chose" là quá khứ.
  • D
    to choosing — sai · "to choosing" sai cấu trúc.

✔ Đáp án đúng: B
  • A
    necessity — sai · "necessity" là danh từ.
  • B
    necessary — đúng · sau "is" cần tính từ: "No experience is necessary".
  • C
    necessarily — sai · "necessarily" là trạng từ.
  • D
    necessitate — sai · "necessitate" là động từ.

✔ Đáp án đúng: B
  • A
    take — sai · "take a reference" không phải cách dùng tự nhiên.
  • B
    receive — đúng · "receive a reference" = nhận thư giới thiệu.
  • C
    catch — sai · "catch" không hợp nghĩa.
  • D
    win — sai · "win" dùng với giải thưởng, cuộc thi.

✔ Đáp án đúng: A
  • A
    on — đúng · "on the first Saturday" – giới từ "on" dùng với thứ/ngày.
  • B
    by — sai · "by" chỉ thời hạn.
  • C
    in — sai · "in" dùng với tháng/năm.
  • D
    at — sai · "at" dùng với giờ.

✔ Đáp án đúng: B
  • A
    through — sai · "through email" nói về kênh nhưng không tự nhiên bằng "by".
  • B
    by — đúng · "apply by email" = nộp đơn bằng email.
  • C
    with — sai · "with email" không dùng trong cụm này.
  • D
    on — sai · "on email" không đúng.

exercises.title: Câu 18–25 · Đọc hiểu
exercises.instruction: Đọc bài đọc rồi chọn đáp án đúng nhất cho mỗi câu hỏi (câu 18–25).
exercises.passage:
1Tet, the Lunar New Year, is the most important festival in Viet Nam. It marks the arrival of spring and is a time when family members, no matter how far apart they live, try to be together.

2In the weeks before Tet, people clean and decorate their houses, buy flowers such as peach blossom and kumquat trees, and prepare traditional foods like banh chung. These activities are not only practical but also symbolic: cleaning is believed to sweep away bad luck, while flowers are thought to bring happiness for the coming year.

3On New Year’s Eve, families gather to share a meal and wait for midnight. In the morning, children receive lucky money in red envelopes after wishing their grandparents and parents good health. Visiting relatives and old teachers during the first days of the year is also a common custom.

4Although modern life has changed many things, Tet remains a strong link between generations. Even young people who work in distant cities usually return home to celebrate it, showing how deeply the festival is rooted in Vietnamese culture.

(Adapted from a cultural guide)
exercises.tr: Tết là lễ quan trọng nhất của Việt Nam: dọn nhà, trang trí, làm bánh chưng, đoàn tụ gia đình, lì xì và thăm họ hàng; dù cuộc sống hiện đại thay đổi, Tết vẫn gắn kết các thế hệ.

items.q: The phrase “no matter how far apart they live” in paragraph 1 is closest in meaning to ____________.
items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: B
  • A
    unless they live together — sai · "unless they live together" sai nghĩa.
  • B
    however distant their homes are — đúng · "no matter how far" = dù ở xa đến đâu.
  • C
    because they live far away — sai · "because they live far" sai quan hệ.
  • D
    only if they live nearby — sai · "only if nearby" ngược nghĩa.

items.q: According to paragraph 2, cleaning the house before Tet is believed to ____________.
items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: B
  • A
    bring wealth immediately — sai · không nhắc giàu ngay.
  • B
    remove bad luck — đúng · đoạn 2: "sweep away bad luck".
  • C
    attract visitors — sai · không nhắc thu hút khách.
  • D
    cure illnesses — sai · không nhắc chữa bệnh.

items.q: The word “it” in paragraph 4 refers to ____________.
items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: A
  • A
    Tet — đúng · "return home to celebrate it" – "it" = Tet.
  • B
    culture — sai · "culture" đứng sau, không phải đối tượng "celebrate".
  • C
    the city — sai · "the city" là nơi làm việc, không được ăn mừng.
  • D
    life — sai · "life" không phải thứ được ăn mừng.

items.q: Which of the following is NOT mentioned as a Tet custom?
opts: Setting off fireworks in the street
items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: D
  • A
    Visiting relatives — sai · có nhắc thăm họ hàng.
  • B
    Giving lucky money — sai · có nhắc lì xì.
  • C
    Preparing traditional foods — sai · có nhắc chuẩn bị món truyền thống.
  • D
    Setting off fireworks in the street — đúng · bài không nhắc bắn pháo hoa.

items.q: The phrase “return home” in paragraph 4 could be best replaced by ____________.
items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: C
  • A
    stay in the cities — sai · "stay in the cities" ngược nghĩa.
  • B
    travel abroad — sai · "travel abroad" khác nghĩa.
  • C
    go back to their families — đúng · "return home" = quay về nhà.
  • D
    leave their jobs — sai · "leave their jobs" khác nghĩa.

items.q: Which of the following best paraphrases the sentence “Tet remains a strong link between generations”?
opts: Only older people celebrate Tet today.
Tet separates generations from each other.
Tet continues to connect older and younger people.
Tet has lost its meaning for young people.
items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: C
  • A
    Only older people celebrate Tet today. — sai · "Only older people" sai.
  • B
    Tet separates generations from each other. — sai · "separates" ngược nghĩa.
  • C
    Tet continues to connect older and younger people. — đúng · đúng nghĩa: Tết vẫn gắn kết các thế hệ.
  • D
    Tet has lost its meaning for young people. — sai · "lost its meaning" ngược nghĩa.

items.q: Which of the following is TRUE according to the passage?
opts: Children receive lucky money after wishing their elders good health.
Young people never return home for Tet.
Families celebrate Tet separately from relatives.
Tet is a minor festival in Viet Nam.
items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: A
  • A
    Children receive lucky money after wishing their elders good health. — đúng · đoạn 3 nêu rõ.
  • B
    Young people never return home for Tet. — sai · đoạn 4: người trẻ thường về nhà.
  • C
    Families celebrate Tet separately from relatives. — sai · đoạn 1 & 3: gia đình sum họp.
  • D
    Tet is a minor festival in Viet Nam. — sai · đoạn 1: lễ quan trọng nhất.

items.q: Which of the following best summarises the passage?
opts: Modern life has ended all traditional customs.
Tet is mainly a festival for children.
Tet is celebrated only in the countryside.
Tet is a deeply rooted festival that brings families together through meaningful customs.
items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: D
  • A
    Modern life has ended all traditional customs. — sai · "ended all customs" ngược.
  • B
    Tet is mainly a festival for children. — sai · "mainly for children" sai.
  • C
    Tet is celebrated only in the countryside. — sai · "only countryside" không nhắc.
  • D
    Tet is a deeply rooted festival that brings families together through meaningful customs. — đúng · tóm tắt: ý nghĩa gắn kết gia đình qua phong tục.

exercises.title: Câu 26–30 · Sắp xếp câu
exercises.instruction: Chọn phương án sắp xếp các câu/lời thoại thành một đoạn hội thoại hoặc đoạn văn hợp lý (câu 26–30).
exercises.passage:
Câu 26

a. Hoa: I think I’m going to fail the physics test tomorrow.

b. Hoa: Could you help me with the last chapter?

c. Binh: Don’t worry. We can study together this evening.

Câu 27

a. Guide: Welcome to the Museum of History! Here is your ticket.

b. Visitor: Thank you. Where can I find the exhibition on ancient tools?

c. Guide: It’s on the second floor, next to the café.

d. Visitor: Great, I’ll go there first.

Câu 28

Dear Ms Green,

a. Thank you very much for inviting me to your wedding next month.

b. Unfortunately, I will be abroad on a business trip on that day.

c. I hope you and your husband will have a wonderful celebration.

d. Please accept my best wishes.

Yours, Hanh

Câu 29

a. Firstly, it is a good chance to try new foods and traditions.

b. Studying abroad can be an unforgettable experience for young people.

c. Secondly, students become more independent when they live far from home.

d. Therefore, many young people consider it a valuable opportunity.

Câu 30

a. This helps both the climate and the people who live in these areas.

b. Many cities are planting more trees along their streets.

c. Trees provide shade, which lowers temperatures in summer.

d. They also absorb pollution and make the air cleaner.

items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: D
  • A
    a – b – c — sai · c là lời đáp lại ý lo lắng, b chưa có lời đề nghị.
  • B
    c – a – b — sai · c là lời an ủi nhưng chưa có điều gì để an ủi.
  • C
    b – a – c — sai · b đề nghị giúp khi chưa có lý do.
  • D
    a – c – b — đúng · Hoa lo lắng (a) → Bình an ủi (c) → Hoa nhờ giúp (b).
💡 Câu an ủi phải theo sau câu bày tỏ lo lắng.

✔ Đáp án đúng: A
  • A
    a – b – c – d — đúng · chào (a) → hỏi (b) → chỉ đường (c) → phản hồi (d).
  • B
    b – a – c – d — sai · b là câu của khách, a là lời chào cần đứng đầu.
  • C
    a – c – b – d — sai · c trả lời câu hỏi chưa được hỏi.
  • D
    a – b – d – c — sai · d phản hồi chỉ dẫn c, phải đứng sau c.
💡 Hỏi → đáp → cảm ơn/chốt.

✔ Đáp án đúng: B
  • A
    b – a – c – d — sai · b nói "Unfortunately" trước khi cảm ơn lời mời.
  • B
    a – b – c – d — đúng · cảm ơn (a) → từ chối (b) → chúc (c) → lời kết (d).
  • C
    a – c – b – d — sai · c chúc mừng trước khi nói không dự được là lạc nhịp.
  • D
    a – b – d – c — sai · d là câu chốt nên để cuối.
💡 Thư từ chối: cảm ơn → lý do/từ chối → chúc.

✔ Đáp án đúng: C
  • A
    a – b – c – d — sai · a không thể mở đoạn khi chưa có câu chủ đề.
  • B
    b – c – a – d — sai · "Secondly" đứng trước "Firstly".
  • C
    b – a – c – d — đúng · chủ đề (b) → Firstly (a) → Secondly (c) → kết (d).
  • D
    b – a – d – c — sai · d là kết, không đứng trước c.
💡 "Therefore" kết luận từ các lý do vừa nêu.

✔ Đáp án đúng: A
  • A
    b – c – d – a — đúng · chủ đề (b) → lợi ích 1 (c) → lợi ích 2 "also" (d) → kết quả (a).
  • B
    b – a – c – d — sai · "This" ở a phải thay cho ý đã nêu trước.
  • C
    c – b – d – a — sai · c nói về "Trees" nhưng chưa có b giới thiệu.
  • D
    b – d – c – a — sai · d có "also" nên phải sau c.
💡 "also" cho biết đây là ý bổ sung sau ý đầu.

exercises.title: Câu 31–40 · Đọc hiểu
exercises.instruction: Đọc bài đọc rồi chọn đáp án đúng nhất cho mỗi câu hỏi (câu 31–40).
exercises.passage:
1[I] The world’s demand for energy is growing every year, and most of it is still produced by burning coal, oil and gas. [II] These fuels release carbon dioxide, the main cause of climate change. [III] As a result, many countries are turning to renewable sources such as sunlight, wind and water. [IV]

2Solar panels convert sunlight directly into electricity and can be installed on rooftops, which means that ordinary households can produce their own power. Wind turbines, meanwhile, are built in open areas or at sea where strong winds blow steadily. Both technologies have become much cheaper over the past decade, making them competitive with traditional fuels in many regions.

3Despite this progress, renewable energy faces obstacles. Sunlight and wind are not constant, so electricity must be stored in batteries for use when the weather is calm or the sun has set. Building large solar or wind farms also requires a great deal of land, and local residents sometimes object to the noise or appearance of the turbines.

4Governments can speed up the change by offering financial incentives and investing in modern power grids. If they do so, clean energy could supply most of the world’s electricity within a few decades. Individuals can contribute as well, for example by switching off unused appliances and choosing energy-efficient products.

(Adapted from an environmental report)
exercises.tr: Nhu cầu năng lượng tăng, các nước chuyển sang năng lượng mặt trời, gió; giá rẻ hơn nhưng không ổn định, cần lưu trữ, cần nhiều đất; chính phủ và cá nhân cùng hành động có thể giúp năng lượng sạch cung cấp phần lớn điện trong vài thập kỷ.

items.q:
Where in paragraph 1 does the following sentence best fit?
Burning them for energy has therefore become one of the greatest threats to the planet.
items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: C
  • A
    [I] — sai · Vị trí [I] đứng trước khi nhắc nhiên liệu/CO2 nên "them" và "therefore" thiếu căn cứ.
  • B
    [II] — sai · Vị trí [II] đứng trước câu CO2, nên "therefore" chưa có nguyên nhân.
  • C
    [III] — đúng · "Burning them" chỉ nhiên liệu hóa thạch và "therefore" nối với việc thải CO2 (câu [II]); đặt trước câu [III] "As a result…" là hợp lý.
  • D
    [IV] — sai · Vị trí [IV] đã sau câu nói về năng lượng tái tạo, không còn hợp mạch.

items.q: The word “competitive” in paragraph 2 could be best replaced by ____________.
items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: D
  • A
    too costly — sai · "too costly" ngược nghĩa.
  • B
    less efficient — sai · "less efficient" ngược nghĩa.
  • C
    unable to compete — sai · "unable to compete" ngược nghĩa.
  • D
    able to rival — đúng · "competitive with" = có thể sánh ngang.

items.q: According to paragraph 2, ordinary households can produce electricity by ____________.
items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: D
  • A
    burning more coal — sai · đốt than trái nghĩa năng lượng sạch.
  • B
    using large batteries only — sai · pin lưu trữ không tạo điện.
  • C
    building wind farms at sea — sai · trang trại gió ngoài khơi không phải hộ gia đình.
  • D
    installing solar panels on roofs — đúng · đoạn 2: pin mặt trời lắp trên mái nhà.

items.q: The word “them” in paragraph 2 refers to ____________.
items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: B
  • A
    regions — sai · "regions" ở cuối câu, không phải chủ thể.
  • B
    solar panels and wind turbines — đúng · "Both technologies… making them competitive" – "them" = hai công nghệ.
  • C
    households — sai · "households" không phải chủ thể giá rẻ.
  • D
    fuels — sai · "fuels" là đối tượng so sánh.

items.q: Which of the following is NOT mentioned as an obstacle to renewable energy?
opts: Solar panels cannot be installed on roofs.
Sunlight and wind are not constant.
Residents may object to the turbines.
Large farms need a lot of land.
items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: A
  • A
    Solar panels cannot be installed on roofs. — đúng · bài nói ngược lại: pin lắp được trên mái.
  • B
    Sunlight and wind are not constant. — sai · có nêu không liên tục.
  • C
    Residents may object to the turbines. — sai · có nêu người dân phản đối.
  • D
    Large farms need a lot of land. — sai · có nêu cần nhiều đất.

items.q: Which of the following best paraphrases the underlined sentence in paragraph 4?
opts: Most of the world’s electricity already comes from clean energy.
Clean energy will replace all fuels within one year.
With government support, clean energy might provide most electricity in the coming decades.
Governments will definitely stop using clean energy.
items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: C
  • A
    Most of the world’s electricity already comes from clean energy. — sai · "already comes" sai.
  • B
    Clean energy will replace all fuels within one year. — sai · "within one year" sai.
  • C
    With government support, clean energy might provide most electricity in the coming decades. — đúng · đúng ý: nếu chính phủ hỗ trợ thì năng lượng sạch có thể cung cấp phần lớn điện.
  • D
    Governments will definitely stop using clean energy. — sai · "stop using" ngược nghĩa.

items.q: Which of the following is TRUE according to the passage?
opts: Batteries are needed to store electricity when there is no sun or wind.
Renewable energy has become more expensive recently.
Fossil fuels do not release carbon dioxide.
Wind turbines work only on rooftops.
items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: A
  • A
    Batteries are needed to store electricity when there is no sun or wind. — đúng · đoạn 3 nêu rõ.
  • B
    Renewable energy has become more expensive recently. — sai · đoạn 2: rẻ hơn.
  • C
    Fossil fuels do not release carbon dioxide. — sai · đoạn 1: có thải CO2.
  • D
    Wind turbines work only on rooftops. — sai · đoạn 2: nơi trống hoặc ngoài khơi.

items.q: Which of the following can be inferred from the passage?
opts: Government policies can influence how fast clean energy spreads.
Wind farms never cause any disagreement.
Individuals cannot help to save energy.
items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: A
  • A
    Government policies can influence how fast clean energy spreads. — đúng · đoạn 4: chính phủ có thể đẩy nhanh quá trình.
  • B
    Wind farms never cause any disagreement. — sai · đoạn 3 nêu người dân phản đối.
  • C
    Coal is cleaner than sunlight. — sai · phi lý.
  • D
    Individuals cannot help to save energy. — sai · đoạn 4 nói cá nhân có thể đóng góp.

items.q: In which paragraph does the writer mention storing electricity?
items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: C
  • A
    Paragraph 1 — sai · đoạn 1 nói nhu cầu và nhiên liệu.
  • B
    Paragraph 2 — sai · đoạn 2 nói công nghệ.
  • C
    Paragraph 3 — đúng · đoạn 3: "stored in batteries".
  • D
    Paragraph 4 — sai · đoạn 4 nói chính sách.

items.q: Which of the following best summarises the passage?
opts: Fossil fuels are the best source of energy.
Only governments can reduce the use of fossil fuels.
Renewable energy is promising, but it needs solutions to its problems and support from governments and individuals.
Renewable energy is useless because the sun does not always shine.
items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: C
  • A
    Fossil fuels are the best source of energy. — sai · "best source" ngược bài.
  • B
    Only governments can reduce the use of fossil fuels. — sai · "Only governments" sai.
  • C
    Renewable energy is promising, but it needs solutions to its problems and support from governments and individuals. — đúng · tóm tắt đủ: tiềm năng, trở ngại, hỗ trợ.
  • D
    Renewable energy is useless because the sun does not always shine. — sai · "useless" cực đoan.

src: Đề tự soạn bám cấu trúc đề tham khảo THPT 2025–2026, chủ đề tình nguyện – tái chế – mạng xã hội – lễ hội – năng lượng tái tạo

title: Đề 07 · Đề tự soạn theo ma trận THPT 2026 (số 5)

exercises.title: Câu 1–8 · Đọc hiểu
exercises.instruction: Đọc bài đọc rồi chọn đáp án đúng nhất cho mỗi câu hỏi (câu 1–8).
exercises.passage:
1Many teenagers today say they feel under pressure to be perfect. Messages on social media show friends travelling, winning prizes and looking flawless, and it is easy to believe that everyone else is happier or more successful.

2Psychologists call this habit “social comparison”. In small amounts, it can motivate people to improve. However, when it becomes constant, it often leads to low self-esteem and anxiety. The problem is that what we see online is usually only the best part of someone’s life, carefully chosen and edited before it is shared.

3To reduce the pressure, experts suggest limiting the time spent on social media and following accounts that make us feel positive. They also advise young people to speak openly about their feelings. Schools can help by teaching students how to think critically about what they see online.

4Ultimately, being yourself is more valuable than trying to match an image that does not exist. Real confidence grows from accepting both strengths and weaknesses.

(Adapted from a health website)
exercises.tr: Việc so sánh bản thân với hình ảnh hoàn hảo trên mạng xã hội gây áp lực, hạ thấp lòng tự trọng; chuyên gia khuyên hạn chế thời gian, theo dõi tài khoản tích cực, chia sẻ cảm xúc và chấp nhận bản thân.

items.q: The word “flawless” in paragraph 1 is OPPOSITE in meaning to ____________.
items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: A
  • A
    imperfect — đúng · "flawless" = hoàn hảo, trái nghĩa "imperfect".
  • B
    faultless — sai · "ideal", "faultless", "spotless" đều đồng nghĩa.
  • C
    ideal — sai · "ideal", "faultless", "spotless" đều đồng nghĩa.
  • D
    spotless — sai · "ideal", "faultless", "spotless" đều đồng nghĩa.

items.q: According to paragraph 2, social comparison can be positive when ____________.
items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: B
  • A
    it causes anxiety — sai · "causes anxiety" là tác hại.
  • B
    it happens in small amounts — đúng · đoạn 2: "In small amounts, it can motivate".
  • C
    it lowers self-esteem — sai · "lowers self-esteem" là tác hại.
  • D
    it becomes constant — sai · "constant" gây hại.

items.q: The phrase “carefully chosen and edited” in paragraph 2 suggests that online posts are ____________.
items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: D
  • A
    never changed — sai · "never changed" mâu thuẫn "edited".
  • B
    always honest — sai · "always honest" mâu thuẫn.
  • C
    accidentally shared — sai · "accidentally" mâu thuẫn "carefully".
  • D
    not completely realistic — đúng · được chọn lọc và chỉnh sửa nên không hoàn toàn thật.

items.q: The word “They” in paragraph 3 refers to ____________.
items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: A
  • A
    experts — đúng · "They also advise…" – chuyên gia.
  • B
    schools — sai · "schools" xuất hiện sau.
  • C
    accounts — sai · "accounts" là đối tượng theo dõi.
  • D
    teenagers — sai · "teenagers" ở đoạn 1.

items.q: Which of the following is NOT mentioned as advice in paragraph 3?
items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: A
  • A
    Deleting all social media accounts — đúng · bài không khuyên xóa hết tài khoản.
  • B
    Speaking openly about feelings — sai · có nhắc nói ra cảm xúc.
  • C
    Limiting time online — sai · có nhắc hạn chế thời gian.
  • D
    Following positive accounts — sai · có nhắc theo dõi tài khoản tích cực.

items.q: Which of the following best paraphrases the sentence “Real confidence grows from accepting both strengths and weaknesses”?
opts: True confidence develops when people accept their good and bad points.
Confidence comes only from being perfect.
items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: B
  • A
    People should hide their weaknesses. — sai · "hide weaknesses" ngược.
  • B
    True confidence develops when people accept their good and bad points. — đúng · đúng nghĩa.
  • C
    Confidence comes only from being perfect. — sai · "only from being perfect" sai.
  • D
    Strengths matter more than anything. — sai · "matter more than anything" sai.

items.q: Which of the following is TRUE according to the passage?
opts: Experts say young people should avoid talking about feelings.
Everyone online is happier than the writer.
Schools can teach students to think critically about online content.
items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: C
  • A
    Experts say young people should avoid talking about feelings. — sai · đoạn 3: nên nói ra.
  • B
    Everyone online is happier than the writer. — sai · không có trong bài.
  • C
    Schools can teach students to think critically about online content. — đúng · đoạn 3 nêu rõ.
  • D
    Social comparison is always helpful. — sai · đoạn 2: chỉ tốt khi ít.

items.q: Which of the following best summarises the passage?
opts: Comparing ourselves with idealised online images can harm us, so we should limit it and accept ourselves.
Social media is the best way to build confidence.
Psychologists have no advice for young people.
items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: B
  • A
    Teenagers should never use technology. — sai · cực đoan.
  • B
    Comparing ourselves with idealised online images can harm us, so we should limit it and accept ourselves. — đúng · tóm tắt đủ ý.
  • C
    Social media is the best way to build confidence. — sai · ngược bài.
  • D
    Psychologists have no advice for young people. — sai · sai vì có lời khuyên.

exercises.title: Câu 9–14 · Điền từ vào đoạn
exercises.instruction: Đọc đoạn văn rồi chọn phương án phù hợp nhất cho từng chỗ trống đánh số (câu 9–14).
exercises.passage:
Summer Camp for Teens

Join our two-week summer camp in Da Lat and make friends from all over the country! The camp is open 9 students aged 14 to 17.

Activities

Every morning, you will take part 10 outdoor activities such as hiking, camping and cycling. In the afternoon, you can choose 11 cooking, painting and drama workshops.

Registration

Places are 12, so please register early. The fee includes meals, transport and 13. For more details, visit our website or call the number 14 below.

items.xh:
✔ Đáp án đúng: D
  • A
    for — sai · "open for" ít dùng với đối tượng này.
  • B
    with — sai · "with" sai giới từ.
  • C
    at — sai · "at" sai giới từ.
  • D
    to — đúng · "be open to sb" = dành cho ai.

✔ Đáp án đúng: B
  • A
    of — sai · "on", "at", "of" không đi với "take part".
  • B
    in — đúng · "take part in" = tham gia.
  • C
    at — sai · "on", "at", "of" không đi với "take part".
  • D
    on — sai · "on", "at", "of" không đi với "take part".

✔ Đáp án đúng: B
  • A
    during — sai · "during" chỉ thời gian.
  • B
    among — đúng · chọn một trong số nhiều (cooking, painting, drama): "among".
  • C
    between — sai · "between" dùng với hai đối tượng.
  • D
    since — sai · "since" chỉ mốc thời gian.

✔ Đáp án đúng: B
  • A
    limiting — sai · "limiting" mang nghĩa chủ động.
  • B
    limited — đúng · sau "are" cần tính từ: "limited" (có hạn).
  • C
    limit — sai · "limit" là động từ/danh từ.
  • D
    limitation — sai · "limitation" là danh từ.

✔ Đáp án đúng: A
  • A
    accommodation — đúng · danh từ song song với "meals", "transport".
  • B
    accommodating — sai · các dạng còn lại là động từ/tính từ.
  • C
    accommodated — sai · các dạng còn lại là động từ/tính từ.
  • D
    accommodate — sai · các dạng còn lại là động từ/tính từ.

✔ Đáp án đúng: A
  • A
    given — đúng · "the number given below" – quá khứ phân từ rút gọn.
  • B
    give — sai · "give" sai dạng.
  • C
    gave — sai · "gave" sai dạng.
  • D
    giving — sai · "giving" mang nghĩa chủ động.

exercises.title: Câu 15–19 · Sắp xếp câu
exercises.instruction: Chọn phương án sắp xếp các câu/lời thoại thành một đoạn hội thoại hoặc đoạn văn hợp lý (câu 15–19).
exercises.passage:
Câu 15

a. Lan: Excuse me, is this seat taken?

b. Man: No, please sit down.

c. Lan: Thank you. It’s so crowded today.

Câu 16

a. Tom: Have you finished the project yet?

b. Anna: Not yet. I still have to do the conclusion.

c. Tom: I can help you if you like.

d. Anna: That would be great, thanks!

Câu 17

Dear Mr Brown,

a. I am writing to apply for the part-time job advertised on your website.

b. I am a second-year student and have worked as a volunteer tutor for two years.

c. I would be grateful if you could consider my application.

d. I look forward to hearing from you.

exercises.passage:
1[I] Fifty years ago, many of today’s most popular jobs did not exist. [II] Software developers, social media managers and drone operators were unknown in the past. [III] Experts now predict that the speed of change will increase even more in the coming decades. [IV]

2Artificial intelligence is expected to take over routine tasks such as data entry, basic customer service and simple translation. At the same time, it will create demand for people who can build, manage and check these systems. Jobs that require creativity, empathy and complex problem-solving, such as teaching, nursing and design, are less likely to be automated.

3Because of these trends, workers will probably need to change careers several times during their lives. Learning will no longer stop after university; instead, people will update their skills continuously through short online courses and training programmes. Employers, too, are looking for “soft skills” like teamwork and communication, which machines cannot easily copy.

4For young people, the best preparation is to stay curious and flexible. Those who learn how to learn will adapt more easily than those who rely on a single set of skills. Schools and parents can support them by encouraging projects, discussion and practical experience rather than memorisation alone.

(Adapted from a career-guidance report)

exercises.title: Câu 23–32 · Đọc hiểu
exercises.instruction: Đọc bài đọc rồi chọn đáp án đúng nhất cho mỗi câu hỏi (câu 23–32).
exercises.passage:
1[I] Online learning has grown rapidly, especially since schools around the world were forced to close during recent years. [II] Millions of students discovered that lessons could be delivered through video calls and learning platforms. [III] Many of them have continued to use these tools even after returning to classrooms. [IV]

2One of the main advantages is flexibility. Learners can study at their own pace, review difficult parts of a lesson and choose the time that suits them best. In addition, online courses give students in remote areas access to teachers and materials that would otherwise be out of reach.

3However, online learning is not perfect. Without a teacher present, some students lose motivation or become easily distracted. Others do not have a stable internet connection or a suitable device, which makes it difficult for them to take part. Social interaction, which is important for emotional development, is also limited.

4Many educators therefore support “blended learning”, a combination of classroom and online activities. This approach keeps the personal contact of traditional lessons while using technology to make them more engaging. With careful planning, it may become the standard model of education in the future.

(Adapted from an education report)
exercises.tr: Học trực tuyến phát triển nhanh; linh hoạt, tiếp cận được vùng xa nhưng thiếu động lực, hạ tầng và tương tác; mô hình kết hợp có thể là hướng đi.

  • C

  • D

exercises.instruction: Đọc bài đọc rồi chọn đáp án đúng nhất cho mỗi câu hỏi (câu 33–40).
exercises.passage:
1Sports play an important role in the life of students. Besides keeping the body strong, they teach young people valuable lessons such as discipline, cooperation and respect for rules.

2In team sports like football and volleyball, players learn that success depends on everyone working together. Even an excellent player cannot win a match alone. Moreover, losing a game can teach students to handle disappointment and to try again, a skill that is useful in every part of life.

3Unfortunately, many schools give sports a low priority. Pupils sit for hours in classrooms and have few chances to exercise. This lifestyle is linked to health problems such as obesity and back pain. Some experts therefore recommend at least one hour of physical activity every day.

4Parents can also encourage children by joining them in activities like swimming or cycling at weekends. In this way, sport becomes a happy habit rather than a duty.

(Adapted from an education journal)
exercises.tr: Thể thao rèn thể lực, kỷ luật, hợp tác; nhiều trường xem nhẹ, học sinh ít vận động; chuyên gia khuyên mỗi ngày ít nhất một giờ; phụ huynh nên đồng hành.

exercises.title: Câu 18–25 · Đọc hiểu
exercises.instruction: Đọc bài đọc rồi chọn đáp án đúng nhất cho mỗi câu hỏi (câu 18–25).
exercises.passage:
1Bicycles were once the main means of transport in many Asian cities. As motorbikes and cars became cheaper, cycling lost its popularity, and the streets became crowded and polluted.

2Today, however, a growing number of people are returning to bicycles. Cycling produces no emissions, costs little to maintain and keeps riders fit. In cities such as Copenhagen and Amsterdam, more than a third of daily trips are made by bike, a figure that other cities hope to match.

3To make cycling safe and attractive, cities must build separate lanes and secure parking places. Public bike-sharing schemes, which allow users to rent a bicycle for a short trip, have also proved successful. Such schemes are especially useful for tourists and for commuters who live near a bus or train station.

4Of course, cycling is not suitable for every journey. Long distances, heavy rain or hot weather may discourage riders. Nevertheless, even replacing a few car journeys each week with bike rides can make a noticeable difference to air quality.

(Adapted from a transport report)
exercises.tr: Xe đạp từng phổ biến, giảm sút rồi quay lại nhờ không khí thải, rẻ, tốt cho sức khỏe; thành phố cần làn riêng, xe đạp công cộng; dù không phù hợp mọi chuyến đi vẫn giúp không khí sạch hơn.

  • C
    noises — sai · các lựa chọn khác không phải khí thải.
  • D
    costs — sai · các lựa chọn khác không phải khí thải.

  • D

  • C

  • D
    the price of bicycles — sai · các đáp án khác không được nhắc là số liệu.

exercises.title: Câu 31–40 · Đọc hiểu
exercises.instruction: Đọc bài đọc rồi chọn đáp án đúng nhất cho mỗi câu hỏi (câu 31–40).
exercises.passage:
1[I] Farming has always depended on the weather, but climate change is making conditions harder to predict. [II] Droughts, floods and storms now damage crops more often than before. [III] To cope with these challenges, many farmers are turning to smart agriculture. [IV]

2Smart farming uses sensors, drones and mobile applications to monitor soil moisture, plant health and weather in real time. With this information, farmers can water and fertilise their fields exactly when and where it is needed, cutting waste and costs. Satellite images even help them to identify diseases before they spread.

3The benefits go beyond individual farms. Using less water and fewer chemicals protects rivers and soil, while higher yields help to feed a growing population. In addition, data collected by farmers can be shared with scientists to improve forecasts and develop new crop varieties.

4However, high-tech tools can be expensive, and many small farmers lack the training to use them. Governments and cooperatives can help by offering low-interest loans and practical courses. If such support is provided, smart farming could become an option for farmers of all sizes.

(Adapted from an agricultural news site)
exercises.tr: Biến đổi khí hậu khiến nông nghiệp khó dự đoán; nông nghiệp thông minh dùng cảm biến, drone giúp tiết kiệm; lợi ích rộng nhưng tốn kém, cần hỗ trợ đào tạo và vay ưu đãi.

src: Đề tự soạn bám cấu trúc đề tham khảo THPT 2025–2026, chủ đề du lịch sinh thái – ngôn ngữ – nông nghiệp thông minh – giao thông xanh – thư viện

title: Đề 10 · Đề tự soạn theo ma trận THPT 2026 (số 8)

exercises.title: Câu 1–10 · Đọc hiểu
exercises.instruction: Đọc bài đọc rồi chọn đáp án đúng nhất cho mỗi câu hỏi (câu 1–10).
exercises.passage:
1[I] Cultural heritage includes monuments, traditional crafts, festivals and stories passed down from one generation to the next. [II] It tells us who we are and where we come from. [III] Unfortunately, many heritage treasures are being lost because of war, natural disasters and neglect. [IV]

2In recent years, technology has offered new ways to protect them. Experts use 3D scanning to create exact digital copies of historic buildings, which can be used to rebuild them if they are damaged. Virtual reality allows people all over the world to explore ancient sites without travelling, reducing the pressure on fragile places.

3Local communities are equally important. Craft villages in Viet Nam, for instance, have kept traditional skills alive for centuries by teaching them to young people. When residents see that heritage brings jobs and pride, they are more willing to protect it. Governments can support these efforts with funding and clear laws.

4Nevertheless, protecting heritage is not only a task for experts or officials. Every citizen can help by respecting historic places, learning about local traditions and sharing them with others. Through such small actions, future generations will still be able to enjoy what we have inherited.

(Adapted from a cultural-heritage report)
exercises.tr: Di sản văn hóa cho biết chúng ta là ai nhưng đang mất dần; công nghệ 3D, thực tế ảo, cộng đồng làng nghề, chính phủ và mỗi công dân cùng bảo vệ.

  • B

  • C
    [III] — đúng · "For this reason" nối với giá trị của di sản ở câu [II]; đặt sau câu [II], tức vị trí [III].
  • D
    [IV] — sai · vị trí [IV] sau câu nói về mất mát, "For this reason" không còn mạch.

City dwellers are exposed to noise from traffic, construction and entertainment venues all day. Research shows that long-term noise can 11 sleep and cause stress.

exercises.title: Câu 33–40 · Đọc hiểu
exercises.instruction: Đọc bài đọc rồi chọn đáp án đúng nhất cho mỗi câu hỏi (câu 33–40).
exercises.passage:
1Extracurricular activities are not part of the official curriculum, but they play a major role in a student’s development. Joining a club or a sports team gives young people the chance to try new things and discover their own interests.

2Such activities also help students build important social skills. When working on a project with classmates, they learn to share ideas, solve conflicts and respect different opinions. Moreover, taking responsibility for a task, for example organising an event, builds confidence and leadership.

3Some parents worry that these activities take time away from study. Research, however, suggests that students who take part in them often achieve better grades because they learn to manage their time more effectively. The key is balance.

4Schools can support students by offering a wide range of activities and by making sure that no one is excluded because of cost. When every learner can find something they enjoy, the whole school community benefits.

(Adapted from an education blog)
exercises.tr: Hoạt động ngoại khóa giúp khám phá sở thích, rèn kỹ năng xã hội, sự tự tin; có thể cải thiện điểm nhờ quản lý thời gian; trường cần đa dạng và không để ai bị loại vì chi phí.
